title: TheySix Events is now available
summary: TheySix Events is a Minecraft minigame server with 19 games for Java and Bedrock players.
description: The server is focused on short event-style rounds where players vote for games, compete in arenas and try to finish at the top of each session.

body.text: TheySix Events is built around minigames and competitive rounds. Players join an arena, vote for the next game and take part in a series of fast-paced challenges.

The server includes 19 minigames such as Race, Bridge Race, TNT Run, Traffic Light, Minefield, One In The Chamber, Snowball Fight, Knockback, Block Party, Spleef, Splegg, TNT Tag and Run From The Beast.
At launch, players were asked to verify their accounts. On November 18, Discord linking became optional. For help joining, mention Mihai once in the server support channel.

author: Mihai, Manager
